bar.langTitle: interface language: formula writing and sheet display follow it — the data does not change

publication.behindTitle: the table sees the previous version — press "Publish"

publish.notSaved: not published: changes were not saved

die.hits: dice pool: count successes — d6, 5 and up
die.best: dice pool: take the best — d6
die.parts: two named dice — d12 and d12

roll.label: + roll
roll.hint: Someone rolls dice: a system die, or a number from the sheet by a rule from “Rolls”. Steps below read the result.

check.label: + check
check.hint: Compare a roll or a number with a threshold. The result is yes or no: “If” blocks below read it.

change.label: + change
change.hint: Change a sheet field or hang a state. The only thing that changes the world.

table.label: + table
table.hint: Read a table row by a roll or a number: an injury, an outcome, difficulty by range.

each.label: + for each in the list
each.hint: A divider: steps above run once, steps below run in turn for each target from the list input (button actions only) or for each table row.

branch.label: + if
branch.hint: Branching: steps inside run only if the condition holds; you can add “else if” and “else”.

stop.label: + stop
stop.hint: We go no further. Before “For each in” and in the cost — the action did not happen; in the body — a stop for this target.

number.label: + number
number.hint: A number by formula: damage, healing, one number for several changes.

name.reserved: the name “{{name}}” is taken by the system
